uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-2506-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2158-2506-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-5060-5258-5618-8095.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-5060-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

277-851-2557-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-4668-5078-7737.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4742-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
3259-4742-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

193-2369-2724-3987.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

1061-4603-4742.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-4742.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-4742.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2079-3457-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-4488.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-4488.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-3967-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-3967-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1429-5402-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-6627.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-6627.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1479-1671-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-6662.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2999-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2999-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Impassioned Orator indestructible.
2999-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-4359-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-4359-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

710-2921-3055.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-2921-3055.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

282-1537-2034-2751.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-1537-2034-2751.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Zealous Conscripts.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Zealous Conscripts.
When the Zealous Conscripts token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Strionic Resonator and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zealous Conscripts token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

230-2252-4050-4365.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2252-4050-4365.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {2}.
Repeat.

230-851-2252-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-851-2252-4050.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {2}.
Repeat.

803-1379-1558-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1379-1558-4302.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

914-2136-2645.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-2645.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Orthion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, and you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability, or use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities.

224-872-1373-3470-4482.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
224-872-1373-3470-4482.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to either tap or untap a creature, or scry 1.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

2961-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

618-2292-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

65-717-2628-4477-4607.description:
Activate Smoldering Crater's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Smoldering Crater, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Smoldering Crater trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Greenwarden of Murasa.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Smoldering Crater from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
